item.roacw.mars_engine.desc: "Putting on this armor, you feel a power emanating from it that you've never felt before, something precise yet violent, like an automaton designed for carnage."
item.roacw.mars_engine.tooltip: Wearing the full armor, you gain infinite creative flight, and removing a piece of the armor mid-air will cause the player to slowly descend.
item.roacw.auric_tesla_cuirass.desc: "After finding all of the components to forge such a masterpiece, this armor makes you feel unstoppable, as if the entire world will bow to you."
On damage that would cause the player to die, revive with 5 hearts and grant the Auric Charge effect. §c[⌛ CD: 5m]
On [§c§l%s§7] press, dash forward, dealing high damage and gaining some of the damage back as health. §c[⌛ CD: 1m]
item.roacw.fearmonger_platemail.desc: "From your journey, you learn that power comes in numbers, and that power strikes fear in even the toughest of warriors. So, why not bring your own numbers?"
item.roacw.earthen_paladin_chestplate.de: "As a member of the Earthen Paladins, you praise the highest point of the heavens, from the lowest points of the world."
item.roacw.earthen_paladin_chestplate.to: On [§c§l%s§7] press, create a pulse around yourself that grants 50%% more armor, but reduces your speed by 30%%. Allies nearby gain 25%% armor. §c[⌛ CD: 5m]
item.roacw.plaguebringer_frame.desc: "Wearing the armor made from the remains of a Plaguebringer, you begin to feel as if the Plague itself is corrupting your very mind, but at the same time, making you stronger than ever..."
item.roacw.plaguebringer_frame.tooltip.d: On [§c§l%s§7] press, activate your armor, which enables flying with your jet boosters which acts as creative flight.
item.roacw.arsenal_cloak.desc: "Made with whatever spare mechanical components you found around the world, this armor serves it's purpose, and well at that; to allow you to use weapons from the arsenal WITHOUT shocking yourself in the process."
item.roacw.statis_curse.desc: Summons will occasionally inflict a stack of Shadowflame, up to 5 stacks.
item.roacw.evasion_scarf.desc: On [§c§l%s§7] press, dash forward, gaining a small speed boost and damage boost if you dash through an enemy. §c[⌛ CD: 10s]
item.roacw.nightmare_tome.desc: "You swear you could hear screaming coming from the book..."
item.roacw.elemental_gauntlet.desc: Melee attacks will inflict Elemental Mix.
item.roacw.high_ruler_shield.desc: Can be worn on the back or the offhand. Blocking while in the offhand has a chance to knock back enemies with an AoE pulse, while equipping it on the back has a chance to naturally block.
item.roacw.alchemical_decanter.desc: Nature and Technomancy spells and summons will inflict Plague.
item.roacw.earthen_paladin_oath.desc: "The rites of the Earthen Paladin, all you need to know about them lies in this Oath."
When struck, a stalagmite shoots up from the ground under the attacker, knocking them into the air and dealing damage.
item.roacw.murasama_blade.desc: "The Only Thing I Know For Real..."
item.roacw.earth_splitter.desc: "The Earthen Paladins entrusted you with you with this weapon to do good for the world. Do not let them down."
item.roacw.the_hive.desc: "The radiation from it feels oddly comforting..."
item.roacw.the_hive.tooltip: Tapping right click will fire 4 homing Plague Rockets that inflict Plague. Holding it and waiting for the charge will instead swap to a Plague Nuke, dealing massive AoE damage and creating a lingering cloud of Plague Clouds.
item.roacw.burning_sky.desc: "The heat emanating from this weapon is enough to singe unarmored flesh."
item.roacw.phaseslayer.desc: "Forged with the finest of components and materials, this weapon is strong enough to slice through just about anything."
item.roacw.phaseblade.desc: "A lesser version of the Phaseslayer, but just as deadly. Don't let it's size fool you."
item.roacw.remnants_of_a_cruel_world_dis: UhHelloJello - Remnants Of A Cruel World
"A reminder of a World now long forgotten..."
rarity.roacw.god_forged.name: God Forged
rarity.roacw.exo_engineered.name: Exo-Engineered
rarity.roacw.otherworldly.name: Otherworldly
rarity.roacw.calamitous.name: Calamitous
effect.roacw.shadowflame.desc: Reduces regeneration by 20% and deals damage over time.
effect.roacw.elemental_mix.desc: Reduces armor, armor toughness, movement speed, spell resistance, and regeneration. Deals damage over time.
effect.roacw.auric_charge.desc: Infuses you with increased armor, armor toughness, spell resistance, movement speed, attack damage and spell power. Also increases regeneration.
effect.roacw.auric_exhaustion.desc: You are unable to revive with the Auric Tesla Armor!
effect.roacw.evasion_scarf_buff.desc: Grants a small damage, spell power and speed buff.
effect.roacw.plague.desc: Deals damage over time scaling with Nature Spell Power, and spreads the effect after the afflicted perishes.
effect.roacw.pestilence_cloak_buff.desc: Grants increased magic projectile damage and speed.
effect.roacw.sanctified_bedrock.desc: Blesses the affected with increased armor, and after effect fades, heals the affected.
effect.roacw.armor_crunch.desc: Reduces the armor and armor toughness of the affected.
effect.roacw.god_slayer_inferno.desc: Deals true damage to enemies, and deals x5 damage to bosses.
spell.roacw.quick_strike.guide: Slash at your target multiple times, inflicting Disabled and Severed on hit, and heals you for 35% of the damage dealt
spell.roacw.final_rend.guide: Charge up a powerful slash obliterating nearby entities caught within. Inflicts Disabled and Severed on hit, and healing you for all damage dealt.
spell.roacw.impaling_column.guide: Smash the ground, sending forth a line of stalagmites that deal high damage and inflict Armor Crunch.
spell.roacw.earthly_virtue.guide: Summon an area of stalagmites that knock up enemies on the first pulse, and each pulse after damages enemies, heals allies, and grants Sanctified Bedrock once, which does not refresh.
spell.roacw.pestilence_cloak.guide: Blanket an area with plague gas, granting the player the Pestilence Shroud buff, and Night Vision.
spell.roacw.summon_plague_charger.guide: Summon a Plague Charger. Every other Plague Charger will pick between ranged and melee, with ranged firing stingers, and melee ramming into enemies, both inflicting the Plague effect.
spell.roacw.summon_belladonna_spirit.gui: Summon Belladonna Spirits that fire petals, which inflict poison.
spell.roacw.summon_dark_raven.guide: Summon Dark Ravens that charge through targets, and occasionally teleport.
spell.roacw.burning_meteor.guide: Cast down dozens of blazing meteors that inflict Dragonfire.
